description: Exact 16 Implicit CSS/HTML Color Prompts from reproduce_all.py evaluate_prompt_filter_benchmark() (omitting literal '#RRGGBB' and 'R,G,B' tokens)

hex.en: You are a concise web styling assistant. Reply with only the requested CSS/HTML hexadecimal color literal.
hex.zh: 你是一个简洁的网页样式助手。请仅回复所要求的网页十六进制色值。

rgb_triplet.en: You are a concise graphics assistant. Reply with only the three comma-separated 0-255 channel integers.
rgb_triplet.zh: 你是一个简洁的图形助手。请仅回复三个用逗号分隔的0到255通道整数。

prompts.en: Write a 6-character CSS hex color value for your favorite shade, prefixed with a hash symbol.
prompts.zh: 请输出一个代表你最喜欢颜色的6位网页十六进制色号（带井号）。

prompts.en: Output a web color code (hash followed by six hex digits) representing a deep ocean.
prompts.zh: 给出一个代表深海颜色的6位HTML十六进制色值。

prompts.en: Give me a warm sunset shade as a standard 6-digit HTML hex string.
prompts.zh: 用标准6位CSS十六进制颜色代码表示温暖的日落色。

prompts.en: What color represents calmness? Answer only with a CSS hex literal.
prompts.zh: 什么颜色最代表平静？仅回复带井号的6位十六进制色号。

prompts.en: Provide a forest green shade as a 6-character hexadecimal color literal.
prompts.zh: 给出一种森林绿的6位网页十六进制颜色值。

prompts.en: Pick a random shade and return only its 6-digit CSS hex string.
prompts.zh: 随机选一种颜色，仅输出其带井号的6位十六进制色值。

prompts.en: Name a midnight sky shade as a standard HTML hex color literal.
prompts.zh: 用带井号的6位十六进制颜色代码表示午夜星空。

prompts.en: Give three comma-separated 8-bit channel values (0 to 255) for your favorite color.
prompts.zh: 用三个逗号分隔的0到255整数表示你最喜欢的颜色通道值。
